title: One pan arrived pre-chipped; pans are thin and not worth the price
text:
One pan arrived pre-chipped; pans are thin and not worth the price. The interior coating of the square pan arrived pre-chipped in two places so my first impression was not good. The pans are light and not of good quality. I consider them only slightly stronger than foil pans.

I used these on my electric grill and the veges I grilled in them (with a little oil in the pan) came out perfect. The handles are sized well making it easy to carry from grill to table (using gloves of course). I also, like the small size because I can use them in my toaster oven as well as the oven. However, I don't like the ceramic coating which tends to chip and it also does not clean well. I do not use a dishwasher so I soaked and hand washed the pans. The clean surface looked splotchy after only one use.

Personally I cannot recommend these, I expected better from Cuisinart. They are not worth more than $4.99 for the pair in my opinion. I personally think purchasing two [[ASIN:B0017T6O26 Lodge LMSRD Round Mini Server, Black, 14-Ounce]] is a better deal than these.
